source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how a folded paper action predicts the unfolded symmetric design.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Fold line is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide how a folded paper action predicts the unfolded symmetric' is answered as fold line rather than paper folding.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: paper folding still holds here even though the fold line is a line of symmetry is missing from the stem — on the item about Decide how a folded paper action predicts the unfolded.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Fold line is what produces paper folding, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how a folded paper action predicts the unfolded.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The paper folding rule also covers this: Do not require group-theory language, so it is not an exception — on the item about Decide how a folded paper action predicts the unfolded.

intelligence.enrichment: Folding paper before ink transfer, cutting, or punching forces corresponding positions to coincide, so the unfolded result is symmetric about each fold line.
